Name: Em's Cows
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
Sixteen options for the white and brown cows. Making them softer and more realistic-looking
This includes the cows, baby cows, Marnie's livestock icons and the calves outside her pasture
Available for Content Patcher and Alternative textures
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Df1NMPyM/Cow-Pail.png[/img][/url]

The cows available at Marnie's are:
White cow: Highland, Swiss, Holstein, Roan, Bull, Galloway, Belted
Brown cow: Guernsey, Texas, Hereford, Jersey, HighlandRed, BeltedBrown, Normande

With the CP Config and AT file, all versions can be assigned to both the white and brown cow
For the more rare cow types such as a yak, bison, musk ox and buffalo, see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41502]Em and Harry's Exotic Cattle[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Cows CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

When buying a cow from Marnie, the type gets randomised and can be any of the sixteen options
If you rather choose which colour you buy, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar
[/url]
Alternatively, you can choose ﻿"Em's Cows CP Config"
This allows you to choose one type for your farm with a config.json

The defaults are Holstein for the White Cow and Guernsey for the Brown Cow. To choose a different type:
Open the [i]config.json[/i] file in the Cow mod folder
Replace "[color=#e69138]Holstein[/color]" or "﻿[color=#e69138]Guernsey[/color]" with the name of the type you like
The choice you make also affects Marnie's livestock icon and pasture cows
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MGb2cDyd/Patchnotes.png[/img]

[i]Update 1.1 Included update keys and minor AT script fixes. Now also replaces the baby cows outside at Marnie's
Update 1.2 Five new breeds and improvements on the original animations
Update 1.3 Compatible with livestock bazaar, new breeds, animation improvements[/i]
